Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel for the
Applicantss.
2. Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned DAG, for the State of
Uttarakhand/1 and 2.
3. Mr. Siddharth Jain, learned counsel for the
PNB/Respondent No.4.
4. Present C528 Application has been filed by the
Applicants for quashing the impugned order dated
30.04.2025 issued by respondent no.4-Branch Manager
PNB Branch Arya Nagar Jawalapur, District Haridwar as
well as impugned order dated 12.11.2024 passed in
Sessions Trial No.26 of 2024 "State vs. Ved Prakash @
Vedanand Saraswati & others" in relation to FIR dated
24.08.2022 in Case Crime No.462 of 2022 for the offence
under Sections 147, 148, 149, 307, 120-B, 420, 504 & 506
of IPC registered at Thana Jwalapur, District Haridwar
passed by learned First Additional District & Sessions
Judge Haridwar. Further a prayer has been made to allow
the application no.17 Kha dated 27.09.2024 filed before
the trial court by the Applicants for de-freezing the bank
accounts related to them.
5. Learned counsel for the Applicants submits that
Respondent Bank may be directed to defreeze the bank
account of the Applicants.

6. Learned counsel for the Applicants has placed
reliance on a judgment passed by this Court in the case of
"M/s Satish Industries and another Vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others" wherein, a similar relief has
been sought for defreezing the bank account and it was
granted.
7. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties,
this Court is of the view that freezing of the account of the
Applicants is absolutely illegal and as such the instant
petition deserves to be allowed.
8. Consequently, the present C528 Application stands
disposed of with a direction to the Respondent No.4-
Punjab National Bank (PNB), Branch Arya Nagar,
Jwalapur, District Haridwar, to defreeze the bank accounts
of the Applicants forthwith and permit them to operate
their accounts.
 ( Ash ish Nait h an i, J.)
